text: In 1921 the author Florence Cathcart, who exposes fraudulent spiritualists and lost her fiancé in the war, [agrees to investigate a child ghost at a boys' boarding school|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. She solves the prank quickly, but at half-term, with only a teacher, the housekeeper Maud and a boy named Tom left, a hand [reaches for her from the lake|images|water and drowning]. Soon she glimpses [a man with a shotgun in the corridors|wrong|killing within the family], and the house begins to [give back what she had forgotten|threat|the enemy within].
